title: The Throat Before Utterance

features.name: the-gathering-quiet
features.desc-on-touch: This is the moment before the bird sings, before the motel guest speaks, before any motion claims the air. The archive learns here what silence is.

features.name: the-uttered-waiting
features.desc-on-touch: Sound has not happened yet, but it is already decided. The throat knows what it will say before the breath arrives.

features.name: the-fence-of-breath
features.desc-on-touch: Each post along the fence was planted in silence. Now they stand in rows, and each one waits to carry the first sound that will break through.

features.name: the-vocal-dark
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the throat of the understory, voice is being born. You can feel it but not hear it. The moment between conception and utterance: this is that.

inscription: here the archive learns that every sound is born from older silences

file.name: PreUtterance_Field_Recording_Silence_Collected.mp3
file.note: A recording of the moment before sound. Listeners report hearing what hasn't been spoken yet. Three different animals' calls recorded before they were made.

exits.label: back up the slope toward sound and echo
toward a place where silence learned to speak
